topic: What payload modifications are needed to handle real-time C/N aggregation from millions of terminals without compromising transponder efficiency?
consensus_response: To handle real-time C/N aggregation from millions of terminals without compromising transponder efficiency, regenerative payloads with digital processing units (DPUs) can be used. These payloads enable efficient spectrum sharing and improved link budgets by digitizing the entire waveform but regenerating only a part for exploitation. This approach minimizes interference and improves spectral utilization, while also reducing latency. Additionally, channelizers with analysis filter banks for de-multiplexing uplink signals and synthesis filter banks to regenerate appropriate bands can mitigate interference and optimize array factor shaping.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the importance of efficient spectrum sharing, reduced latency, and improved link budgets in satellite communications. Regenerative payloads with DPUs and channelizers are proposed as solutions to achieve these goals.
